properties.label: IPv4 address
properties.description: Static management IPv4 address. Leave empty or enter dhcp for DHCP.

properties.label: IPv4 netmask
properties.description: Prefix length or dotted IPv4 netmask.

properties.label: Default gateway
properties.description: Optional IPv4 default gateway for static addressing.

properties.label: DNS servers
properties.description: Comma- or space-separated DNS server addresses.

properties.label: Management VLAN
properties.description: Optional VLAN ID from 1 through 4094 on the resolved management interface.

properties.label: SSH authorized key
properties.description: Optional OpenSSH public key for the vyos account.

properties.label: Enable REST API
properties.description: Enable the VyOS REST API over HTTPS.

properties.label: REST API key
properties.description: Full-access API key used when the REST API is enabled.

properties.label: Management network
properties.description: OVF network name used to discover the management interface by MAC address. Empty retains the eth0 fallback.

properties.label: Trunk network
properties.description: OVF network name used to discover the supplemental configuration trunk interface by MAC address.

properties.label: Supplemental configuration
properties.description: Base64-encoded UTF-8 VyOS set and delete commands applied at first boot.
